lines: Mudrā, reflection-natured, is said in the venerable Devyāyāmala, by hearing bimbodaya, from discernment of two predicates.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mudrā ca pratibimbātmā śrīmaddevyākhyayāmale uktā bimbodayaśrutyā vācyadvayavivecanāt
